name: Empyrion - Galactic Survival
tagline: Native connector for Empyrion dedicated servers: one C# mod, loaded by the game's own mod loader, that connects to Takaro itself, no sidecar.
requirements: Empyrion - Galactic Survival Windows dedicated server (Steam app 530870) build named in the release; it also runs under Wine
File access to the server's Content\Mods folder

assets.label: Server mod
assets.requires: Empyrion dedicated server on Windows (or under Wine)
assets.hint: Stop the server, unzip into the server's Content\Mods\ folder, copy Content\Mods\TakaroEmpyrion\TakaroConfig.txt.example to TakaroConfig.txt, set REGISTRATION_TOKEN and SERVER_NAME and start the server.
